why: W8.7. sharedJsGzipKb is the React and Next runtime baseline (measured 139 kB) with headroom, not a target we chose; the numbers to defend are the route, CSS and font lines. Gzipped kilobytes a first view pays for. Raising a number here must be a deliberate, reviewed line in a diff; `node scripts/page-weight.mjs --update` rewrites them to the measured sizes + 10% when a change makes the old numbers meaningless.
